sections.title: French for the Medical Professions
sections.description: How do healthcare systems and approaches to wellness differ across cultural and linguistic contexts? This course, conducted entirely in French, equips students with essential vocabulary and communicative skills—both written and oral—needed to navigate medical environments effectively. Designed for those entering the healthcare field, working with French-speaking patients, volunteering in francophone medical settings, or simply exploring health-related topics, this course is open to anyone with an interest in health.
